hebrewText: אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛י/ךָ יְהוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּ/ךָ לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ וּֽ/לְ/זִכְרְ/ךָ֖ תַּאֲוַת נָֽפֶשׁ

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanation: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.bdb: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
tokens.kjv: manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-) way.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.enLiteralWord: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.explanation: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.explanationEn: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan

tokens.bdb: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
tokens.kjv: [phrase] adversary, ceremony, charge, [idiom] crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, [idiom] worthy, [phrase] wrong.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
tokens.kjv: gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon).
tokens.explanation: qavah — reunir, ajuntar, esperar ansiosamente por algo

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm)
tokens.kjv: dainty, desire, [idiom] exceedingly, [idiom] greedily, lust(ing), pleasant. See also H6914 (קִבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה).

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
tokens.explanation: nefesh — alma, ser vivo, vida, pessoa, desejo interior
